subject: literacy
concept: Comparing two texts on the same topic and noticing similarities and differences
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts fact cards from two related passages into 'same' and 'different' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student fills in a simple venn diagram comparing two short passages
exercise.abstract: Student writes 1-2 sentences comparing two passages on the same topic

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies at least 2 real similarities and 2 real differences
misconception_flags: treats every difference between the texts as a similarity or vice versa

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
